<xform:text property="extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_state)" showStatus="noShow"/><script>AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_value",function(value,domElement){
 var mirror=GetXFormFieldById("fd_state")[0];
 var dependent=$('input[name="extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_value)"]');
 if(value.indexOf("A")>=0){
  mirror.value="A";
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_A_row",true,true,true);
 }else{
  mirror.value="";
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_A_row",false,false,true);
  dependent.val("");
 }
});</script>
<metadata><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_value" label="Value" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_state" label="State" type="String" canDisplay="false"/></metadata>
